verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's own cloud directory page claims to consolidate 'all identities—human, machine, and agent' into one source of truth, a thin first-party signal that agents can be directory identities. Nothing in the pack documents patterns for securing agent access to apps. The password vault is aimed at company secrets generally and is an adjacent feature, not agent token vaulting. Missing for 10: documented cross-app access for agents, token vaulting for agent credentials, scoped/short-lived agent credentials, agent-specific security guidance, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
